tagline.en: Clean up Google Photos: find look-alike duplicates and blurry shots on your computer, bulk delete in batches of up to 500, then restore keepers in HD or turn them into a memory reel. Free on Chrome as Google Photos Delete Tool.
tagline.zh-Hant: 清理 Google 相簿：在你的電腦上找出相似的重複相片和模糊相片，每批最多 500 張批量刪除，再把值得保留的相片修復成高清，或製作成回憶短片。免費 Chrome 擴充功能，商店名稱為 Google Photos Delete Tool。

source.note: Runs on Sylphx: pixzy.ai is the web service declared in the repository root sylphx.toml. The name is the product's own (site/llms.txt: "Pixzy (Google Photos Delete Tool)"); the one-liner follows pixzy.ai and names the Chrome Web Store listing, Google Photos Delete Tool (jiahfbbfpacpolomdjlpdpiljllcdenb), so returning users recognise it.
